system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 2 Basic, 2 Intermediate, 4 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (2): Auguring the Sickness, Tracker's Mark
  • Intermediate (2): King David's Blessing, Peacemaker
  • Advanced (4): Blessing of the Name, Heaven's Gate, Sword of the Righteous, Watching the Passage

Base rating-tracker for the Valeren Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
